author: Danbob wind
attribution: Photo: Danbob wind, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bluefields_street.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Beer-sponsored hanging shop sign (Modelo logo) over a blue building on a Bluefields street. Distractors: big 'el machetazo' promo banner across the street ('¡oleada de ofertas', 'hasta 50 meses de plazo'), 'SUR / COMERCIAL BENDAÑA', 'MIRIAM', 'BLUEFIELDS ESTA CON VOS' banners; a small car with a plate is incidental.

author: Nolabob
attribution: Photo: Nolabob, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bobadilla_SANY0100.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Concrete monument sign with yellow raised letters at the Masaya Volcano crater car park; park logo plaque on the pillar at left. No accents (VOLCAN). Small rules sign in the background is illegible.

author: Christopher Sayan
attribution: Photo: Christopher Sayan, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:La_Paz_Centro_sign_with_background.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.

author: Ridiculopathy
attribution: Photo: Ridiculopathy, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Religious_signs_on_Big_Corn_Island,_Nicaragua_4.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted church board under a tin roof on Big Corn Island; brush lettering, spelling as painted ('meetin', 'reflextion'). Schedule lines: names at left, day/time at right; the 'PM'/'AM' are small superscripts and the last time is partly faded.
source_title: File:Religious signs on Big Corn Island, Nicaragua 4.jpg

author: Christopher Sayan
attribution: Photo: Christopher Sayan, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:El_Sauce-Nicaragua.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Tourism billboard at the entrance to El Sauce (León), angled and partly shaded by foliage; leaves cover the end of 'EL SAUCE' and the end of 'imagen'. Government logo block top left ('Gobierno de Reconciliación y Unidad Nacional', 'El Pueblo, Presidente!'); a graffiti tag sits over the V of VISITENOS.

author: Nolabob
attribution: Photo: Nolabob, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nicarao_2549.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White tourist-attraction board with volcano logo under a tiled roof, seen from a distance with slight blur; small 'Operado por' and contact lines are soft. Painted volcano mural above is decoration.

author: Stoschmidt
attribution: Photo: Stoschmidt, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ometepe04.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Beer-sponsored hanging sign (Victoria logo) plus a hand-painted 'comedor Gloriana' board on the beach at Ometepe, Lake Nicaragua, with Maderas volcano behind. Bathers far away are incidental; a 'LITRO FROST @ 25' beer ad at right is a distractor.
